title: Riot Squad Bar EDTN Red Razz Longfill 30ml
description: Riot Bar EDTN’s Red Razz Longfill features a vibrant and tangy raspberry profile, offering a refreshing and bold taste with each puff. The juicy, tart notes of red raspberries are perfectly captured, making this flavour a great choice for vapers who enjoy intense and fruity e-liquids. This vibrant e-liquid concentrate is crafted for vapers who enjoy fruity, refreshing flavours with a full-bodied character. Riot Bar EDTN Longfills offer an innovative approach to e-liquid customisation, allowing vapers to mix and create a 60ml bottle with their ideal nicotine strength. Each longfill contains 30ml of 0mg e-liquid concentrate in a 60ml bottle, designed to be mixed with VG/PG Mixer Kits (sold separately) , which include a choice of nicotine shots and VG boosters. The Apple & Blackcurrant Longfill is suspended in PG for flexible mixing, allowing users to choose either a higher-VG or balanced VG/PG blend depending on their device preference. Mix with freebase nicotine shots for a high-VG blend suitable for sub-ohm devices or with nic salt shots for a balanced MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) experience. Please note: Riot Bar EDTN Longfill e-liquids are designed to be mixed with a VG/nicotine shot solution and are not suitable for direct vaping. How to use Riot Bar EDTN Longfills: 1. Open your longfill eliquid concentrate bottle and pull out the nib. 2. Pour in all 3 bottles included in your chosen Mixer Kit. 3. Reattach the nib back on the longfill bottle and put the lid on. 4. Shake the bottle vigorously for 1 minute. 5. Your eliquid is ready to vape. Riot Bar EDTN Longfill e-liquids require VG and nicotine shots and are not suitable for direct vaping.
